title: Adaptive Interviewing for Persona Simulation in LLMs: Evidence-Grounded Reasoning Improves Decision Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative error analysis of model reasoning in moral and social dilemma simulations to identify the model's tendency to default to strict rule-following and procedural adherence over a user's actual pragmatic or contextual strategies.

Qualitative error analysis of simulated decisions to observe the model's systematic preference for cooperative, relationship-repairing, and socially harmonious actions, even when the human user preferred disengagement or boundary-setting.

Qualitative evaluation of model predictions in conflict scenarios to detect a tendency to favor ideal, compromise-oriented solutions that attempt to satisfy multiple competing obligations rather than realistic trade-offs.
